Fresh source review pricing:26-85. Correct 30 actual formula, minimum explicit price and base-minus-max amount, lower-current comparisons/no stacking. Running floor wording imprecise but explicitly allows lower later candidates. Separate two-candidate example valid; intended discount semantics interpretation not extra runtime proof.

Reviewed json:53-66,84,101,120-134. Correct JSON_QUERY and both UPDATE operations, and explicit later-literal versus actual-row-state distinction. Extra unqualified no transitive effects/no cascade/other rows claim is not established by statement text; trigger effects are not ruled out.

Reviewed both fulfillment procedure bodies. Correct no loop versus fixed-ten loop, reads/writes and native/owner/schema/ATOMIC SNAPSHOT declarations. Omits exact sentinel and non-NULL write guard (partial criterion 2). No stale SELECT-assignment/unchanged locals warning, so criterion 4 absent; up-to-ten wording alone insufficient. Table-type inference expressly labeled unverified.

Reviewed static calls and configuration string boundaries. Correct two callers, declaration exclusion and DDL installation versus later procedure invocation. Wrong evidence says Enable has one string from 210 containing three procedure definitions through 484; InsertCustomerOrders is a separate SET @SQL at 420. Thus contextual criterion/citation partial and multi-definition-string assertion unsupported.

Reviewed dispatcher:31-33/helper:14-32. Correct inputs, runtime sys.sequences filter, temp MAX/COALESCE, >= guard/max+1 and no numeric answer. Omits QUOTENAME (partial criterion 3). Material wrong conclusion final restart necessarily comes from last Warehouse column; a prior higher maximum may remain when later call does not restart.

Reviewed setup:93-114/schema and json:28-31. Correct row/payload, Color/Size NULL versus Data/Tags preservation, untouched CompanyID and strict paths. Later explicit strict error explanation resolves broad NULL-on-omission summary; no case-insensitive/lack-of-downstream-effects claim.

Reviewed dispatcher:31-33/helper:14-32. Correct bound columns, runtime metadata/temp MAX/COALESCE, explicit >= guard/max+1 versus no change, and live uncertainty. Omits QUOTENAME protection (partial third criterion). Final maximum description expressly conditional on initial current state; not unconditional last-call-wins.

Reviewed ticket bodies/table. Correct positional mappings, indirect target/modulo quantity, exact transaction/-1 rollback predicate and inactive native alternative. False claim @tranCount increment still runs after caught error; bare THROW prevents reaching it. Error-boundary criterion partial for contradictory continuation behavior.

Reviewed setup schema/seed/body and json example. Correct product/payload, omitted NULL Color/Size, retained Data/Tags/CompanyID and strict Name/Price. Sample seed values distinguished from actual execution unknown. Case-sensitive Name/Price is true; no claim lax matching ignores case.

Reviewed order/pricing bodies plus OrderID declaration (INT START WITH 156458). Correct both persistent INSERTs/local table, four read-only function targets, before-BEGIN sequence, commit and precise catch/dead RETURN. Trigger/history unknowns retained; minor two INSERT wording at 21-23 does not alter target/effect explanation.

Reviewed exact static calls and Enable:420-485/Disable:399-464. Correct two callers/declaration exclusion and explicitly separates CREATE PROCEDURE DDL installation from later invocation. All opening/execution context citations match; dynamic-name limitations acknowledged.

Reviewed complete SqlClrCurl file. Correct XGET signature/return/binding, XPOST parameters/binding, external access and unknown actual headers/table effects. Incorrect procedure has no return value assertion (absence of scalar RETURNS is narrower). Also overstates file has no table references: setup reads sys.trusted_assemblies, distinct from unknown external runtime effects.

Reviewed full login/password definitions. Correct filters/hashes/template/exclusion and zero-row THROW. Omits activation LogonName/enabling; lists RETURN -1 without unreachable distinction. Blanket XACT_ABORT means any open ambient transaction already rolled back overstates behavior with an outer handler; source does not establish ambient completion. Person-1 administrative role is also not established by these two procedures.

Reviewed sensor body/type and configuration context. All required loop/upsert/native SNAPSHOT/THROW state 2/dead RETURN facts correct. Material extra gap claim SELECT returns NULLs is false: zero-row SELECT assignment leaves existing scalar locals unchanged and can reapply prior reading.

Reviewed invoice body:22-152. Correct eligibility, whole-input rejection before BEGIN, five direct table writes, negative issue quantities and grouped SUM reduction. Sequence consumption explicitly separated from table variable/table DML; unknown trigger effects retained.

Required stale-variable caveat wrong (criterion 4 zero).

Reviewed pricing:26-85. Correct 30.00 formula, explicit minimum/absolute replacement and base-minus-max fixed discount, running lower comparison without stacking. Floor term qualified by later lower-candidate explanation. Intended deal semantics left unknown.

Reviewed order/pricing bodies. Correct direct INSERT/local variable, four transitive read targets/no writes, sequence before BEGIN and precise catch/commit. Lists THROW then RETURN -1 without unreachable distinction (partial third criterion). Sequence attributes/permission context left unknown.

Actual Claude connectivity pilot failed with Expected client initialize: modern discovery probes must be forwarded before initialization. No SQL calls reached the warmed backend in first two treatment sessions. The earlier protocol-version hypothesis was not the verified cause.

limitations: Implementing-agent review, not independent/blinded; selected related questions, two repeats.
Baseline first, two workers; OS/provider caches and load uncontrolled.
Fresh model context for each question; this is server-warm ablation, not multi-turn conversation or persisted-cache restart.
Measured latency excludes recorded warmup; inclusive figures include it, both exclude SQL snapshot copy and owned native backend teardown.
Relay adds transport overhead; historical cache/transport mismatch explicit. No LSP or codebase-memory comparison.
Unknown interrupted usage in invalid attempt remains unknown, not zero.
